# Move Components into a Separate Folder

#### Course: Build your First Web App with React

## Move Components into a Separate Folder

So far, Header.jsx and EntryCard.jsx have been in the src folder next to App.jsx.

Now we'll add another reusable piece: the form. So this is a good time to reorganize our files by shifting all component files into a components folder.

Why use a components folder?

Because it's a good idea. Putting all reusable UI components in src/components

- keeps the src folder clean (only your main App.jsx and entry files stay at the top level),
- makes it easy to find and add components,
- and scales better as the app grows.

![Component Tree](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Next, let's look at the process of creating this new folder and moving the files into it, step by step.
